sdk_header_policy: No Nintendo SDK headers consulted, copied or supplied. The compiler standard library remains a local toolchain dependency, never part of this package.
baseline: Headers inherit round 2 curation and provenance; additions are independently authored from the public upstream calls and public API/register descriptions.
unproved_layouts: OS synchronization, Thread, DSP Voice/WaveBuffer/FX storage remain incomplete; dependent TUs stay compile-blocked. No padding or dummy storage was introduced.
unproved_constants: SDK-private GL/NnGX constants are not assigned guessed values. Unused enum entries are omitted from curated headers; constructors/address-query helpers depending on them remain declarations. Functions requiring these unresolved bodies cannot be adopted without a full MATCH.
inference: New math/transfer method scalar signatures and PICA SDK-spelling aliases are [INFERENCE] from public usage/hardware semantics; compile success alone is not ABI evidence. Only complete match.py receipts support the adoption units.
assembly_entrypoints: gfx_MemoryUtil.h retains upstream declarations of FastWordCopyAsm_N only; no assembler body is supplied or imported.
projected_enums: Removing unevidenced enum entries is a parse-level header projection, not a claim of complete ABI knowledge. Only accesses exercised by complete-MATCH adoption functions are evidenced.
compiler_path_case_handling: Use main tools/toolchain.py component-wise --depend case resolution. Temporary local compiler aliases were removed; no compiler install change remains.
